_note: Extended labels for data/items.json, created from scratch by three independent model annotators (majority vote) plus an adversarial review; the standard labels (labels.json) were not consulted. Covers all three profiles. Like labels.json, a procedure group is named after its first member in data/items.json order and labels refer to groups; a duplicate or reaction counts as its group. Synthetic / simplified, as of 2026-11.

metals_at.EU-EP-0001: ETS free-allocation benchmarks directly set carbon costs of steel/aluminium installations; vote with amendment deadline.
metals_at.EU-HYS-0003: CBAM extension to downstream steel/aluminium goods such as screws, bolts, profiles hits C24/C25; open call for evidence.
metals_at.EU-LEX-0004: Taxonomy screening criteria for primary aluminium affect green-finance classification of a niche of C24, no direct obligation.
metals_at.EU-HYS-0005: Reusable transport packaging between distribution centres and shops concerns retail logistics, not metal production.
metals_at.EU-EP-0006: Consumer credit at point of sale; no impact on metal producers.
metals_at.EU-CON-0007: Voluntary joint stockpiling of nickel, cobalt etc. may affect input supply indirectly, no obligations.
metals_at.EU-HYS-0008: Sets themes for the Capitals of Culture programme; 'Iron Curtain' is a history theme, nothing for metal producers or fabricators.
metals_at.EU-EP-0009: Horizontal cap on B2B payment terms applies to all metal companies.
metals_at.EU-EPRS-0010: Information-only briefing on energy prices for energy-intensive industries, a core topic for members.
metals_at.EU-LEX-0011: Definitive anti-dumping duty on cold-rolled flat steel is trade defence for C24.
metals_at.EU-HYS-0012: Covers toy-safety checks by online marketplaces and shops selling to consumers; metal producers and fabricators (C24, C25) are not sellers of toys.
metals_at.EU-LEX-0014: Disclosure on discarded unsold consumer products; concerns consumer-goods sellers, not metal producers.
metals_at.AT-PAR-0016: Austrian draft on scrap shipment and scrap-metal records; scrap flows are core for members, consultation open.
metals_at.AT-PAR-0017: Austrian energy-efficiency law: energy audits and implementation duties for large companies, many metal producers.
metals_at.AT-GAZ-0019: Regulates holiday opening hours in Austrian tourism zones, which applies to shops and not to smelters, rolling mills or metalworking firms.
metals_at.AT-GAZ-0020: Austrian compensation of indirect CO2 costs for electricity-intensive firms: funding for metal producers.

agrifood_pl.EU-EP-0001: ETS benchmarks cover only a niche of large food installations (sugar, starch, dairy drying).

agrifood_pl.EU-EPRS-0010: Energy-intensive industry briefing; food processing not its focus.
